preserved_generated_checks_review.name: Default state: T=300 K, eta=1 mPa*s, a=1 um, t=1 s
t=0 gives zero MSD and RMS while D stays positive
Doubling radius halves D and RMS at fixed t

findings.finding: Preserved model-authored expected values omit the default temperature factor 300: expected D about .000732 versus independent/core .2197371130. MSD and RMS expectations inherit this error. CLI gates correctly reject these inconsistent cases; the package has no usable HTML.

The auxiliary conversion-coefficient unit is dimensionally inconsistent with D=C*T/(eta*a). The coefficient must carry diffusivity*viscosity*radius/temperature in the chosen units, equivalently mPa*micrometre^3/K; main D/MSD/RMS units are correct.
The visible auxiliary readout labeled D after doubling viscosity (halves D) evaluates D*2; it should evaluate D/2. The three primary D/MSD/RMS equations remain correct.
Guided numerical prose repeats the erroneous default values; the double-radius check title says RMS halves, whereas RMS divides by sqrt(2).

scope: These are numerical/source reviews of an unchanged partial lesson only. No page was created or hand-repaired; passing primary computations cannot override failed generated expectations and absent HTML.
benchmark_input_qualification: The supplied benchmark excerpts mix a short authentic prose quote, explicitly transcribed equations and authored summaries of source-supported facts. These are focused, enriched inputs rather than raw-paper discovery tests. Several generated grounding quotes promote authored summaries into purported primary-paper quotations; this is a provenance finding and a limitation of benchmark-input representativeness. Inputs were not changed during trials.
